2. Scope of Work Executed
Tunnels works for Mega Infrastructure Authority completed 2014.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included a high water table requiring continuous
dewatering. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for
additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of restricted working hours imposed
near the adjoining school. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's
control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the
approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been
completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending
Engineer.

3. Quality Assessment
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Good. Workmanship was good, with finishing
standards above the specified norm, and third-party inspection was arranged for the structural
elements. Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with this office were
within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. Deficiency / Observation List
At the time of taking over, surface regularity re-tested and accepted on the second attempt. Regarding
site safety, one first-aid case was recorded and closed with a toolbox briefing. The agency's conduct
during the contract is recorded as responsive throughout the defect liability period.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2014-10-25. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the
inspecting authority.
6. Recommendation
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the
joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend
release of the balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability
period. Certified by A. Raghavan, Project Director.
On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
